\section{Related work}
The two accompanying synthetic notes supply the definitions and algebra for this example. The first stipulates the thermal balances and entropy differential under the constant-capacity assumptions~\cite{fixturemodel}; the second records the relaxation solution, entropy rate, and limiting qualifications~\cite{fixturealgebra}. Both are synthetic validation materials rather than external publications. This exposition makes no claim about priority or advances over established heat-transfer theory.
